claim: A fixed season-aware direct six-month ridge AR6 forecast reduces February–April initialized Niño 3.4 RMSE by at least 5% against both persistence and fixed non-seasonal ridge AR6 on held-out issue dates from 2015 onward through the October 25, 2026 data cutoff, with positive paired skill intervals under all prespecified block lengths.
exclusions: Exclude missing sentinel values; internal missing months, duplicate dates, non-finite values, insufficient coverage or missing source evidence stop the run. Use only targets available by cutoff. No imputation.
interpretation: Retrospective pseudo-out-of-sample experiment; no historical-vintage reconstruction, no external preregistration, no physical causal claim. Failure to meet the frozen rule is inconclusive or no demonstrated advantage. Do not change models after inspecting outcomes.
registration: Internal timestamped protocol; not external preregistration
validation: Temporal label cutoff, no model selection using holdout, linear-system residual checks, fresh container reproduction, independent host numerical recomputation and safety probes.
